description: Send an enquiry to a Cyclesite seller on the buyer's behalf. It's saved to the buyer's Cyclesite inbox and the seller is notified. Per-buyer-per-listing daily cap (2/day) prevents spam. Read the seller's reply with get_my_messages. Requires OAuth scope `enquiries:respond` (note: the scope name is shared with seller-side replies). Example: 'message the seller of that Trek and ask if they'd take £1,400 collection only in Manchester next Saturday'.

message.description: The buyer's question to the seller (10-2000 chars).

name: make_enquiry
